required_fixes.defect: The requirement asserts a false repository state: '/tmp/lex_accepted/frontier is EMPTY for every lane and team right now ... the accepted lab/frontier/<team> branches no longer exist.'
required_fixes.evidence: git ls-remote --heads origin lists 11 refs/heads/lab/frontier/* branches, including frontier-counter-anchor-classifier = d236f5990ddee9acf5cf17f59ee1cc3986905d6f and frontier-query-conditioned-map-geometry = dc3ffc6ca00347fcd01689d3356cc5a5abe8493c. The audit mount /tmp/lex_accepted/frontier is NOT empty: it contains frontier-query-conditioned-map-geometry, mounted because main's portfolio v23 (the proposal base) carried that team as RUN (core-lane.yml:119-128 mounts RUN/PROMOTE teams). The accepted counter-anchor-classifier audit gate was fetchable and read (gate=PASS, safe_to_integrate=true, required_fixes=[]).
required_fixes.why_material: This requirement governs how lanes recover the frozen rubrics, and its own successor requirement index 17 (new in this same proposal, 'NO MOUNT IS NOT A REASON TO SKIP INTEGRATION') states the opposite: a TERMINATED team's lab branch is intact and MUST be fetched. A lane that resolves the contradiction the wrong way can conclude the two promoted components are unavailable and drift toward the forbidden move of regenerating, paraphrasing or re-tuning a frozen rubric, bar or support test.
required_fixes.required_repair: Restate the preamble: the lab/frontier/<team> branches EXIST on origin (quote the two promoted shas d236f599 and dc3ffc6c) but are NOT all mounted because core-lane.yml mounts only RUN/PROMOTE teams and no portfolio team is RUN. Keep the RULE clause, both sha256 values (4457e971df3dc5d10af2a727aa675afc15a15564c18eed4cede0af5eb41b4608 and a7452748d40c511a14a1c7848ece5fe7f8f8901cc30f45a66918c89eb593a633) and the cycle-branch fetch paths byte-unchanged.
